meta.name: add-dial-number
meta.description: Add another phone number to an existing Dial channel — a second (or third) public line for the agent, so one NanoClaw install answers SMS and AI voice calls on multiple numbers. Use when Dial is already installed and the operator wants an additional number (e.g. a personal line plus a support line). Requires the Dial channel to already be installed (see /add-dial).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让同一安装接听多个号码
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果要给现有直线添加额外接听号码
copy.tagline_en: Answer calls on multiple numbers from a single installation
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have a Dial channel and need to add another number

howto.what: 在已装好 Dial 通道的 NanoClaw 上新增第二或第三个电话号码。每个号码是独立的线程式线路,短信和 AI 语音来电都交给所选 agent,回复从收到消息的那个号码发出。
howto.when: 当 Dial 通道已装好、你想给 agent 再加一个号码(比如个人线和客服线)时使用。若 Dial 尚未安装,需先运行 /add-dial。

say.text: 给 Dial 再加一个号码:+14155550123
say.note: 会先核对该号码属于当前账号

say.text: 让 ag-1234 这个 agent 组来接这个新号码
say.note: 新增线路绑定到该 agent 组

say.text: 这条线路叫 Support Line,来访策略用 public
say.note: 任何人知道号码都能发消息

howto.what_en: Adds another phone number to an already-installed Dial channel, so one NanoClaw install answers SMS and AI voice calls on multiple numbers. Each number is a separate threaded line; replies leave from the number that received the message.
howto.when_en: Use when Dial is already installed and you want an extra number for the agent. If Dial is missing, run /add-dial first.

say_en.note: Checks the number belongs to your account

say_en.text: Let agent group ag-1234 answer this new number
say_en.note: Wires the new line to that agent group

say_en.text: Name this line Support Line, inbound policy public
say_en.note: Anyone who knows the number can text it
